methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Pre-Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $2M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Drones & Autonomous (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 7 same-sector peers exist in Drones & Autonomous, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
DroneForge is a pre-seed stage company in the Drones & Autonomous sector that has raised $2.5M to date. The broader peer universe comprises 8 private companies operating in drones and autonomous systems, including Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, Joby Aviation, and Nuro. No public comparables exist in this narrow segment.

Stage-progression valuation is the applicable triangulation method given the absence of sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage peers in the drones sector (0 narrow-filter matches across 7 same-sector companies). Using total capital raised ($2.5M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical pre-seed to next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $6M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $5M to $7M, centered on $6M. The single-method triangulation reflects material uncertainty: peer-median analysis could not be applied due to insufficient comparable data at similar stage and valuation tier within the drone subsector. Key uncertainties include the absence of public market benchmarks, limited private comparable transactions at pre-seed stage in this sector, and early-stage revenue or technical milestone visibility. Any refinement of this range would require either additional pre-seed transactions in autonomous systems or broader sector multiples calibrated to later-stage peers, both of which carry elevated assumption risk at this stage.
